cohort: The study included all women who gave birth at Sivas Cumhuriyet University Hospital Gynecology and Obstetrics Clinic between March 1st and August 31st of both 2019 (pre-pandemic) and 2020 (pandemic).
finding: There was no significant difference in birth outcomes between the pre-pandemic and pandemic periods, except for a slightly earlier gestational age at birth in the pre-pandemic period.
mod_finding: Birth patterns and modes of delivery were similar between the pre-pandemic and pandemic periods.
gest_age: Births occurred at slightly earlier gestational ages in the pre-pandemic period compared to the pandemic period.
